papers.zh: 设计具光致可逆固-液转变的偶氮聚合物光刻胶，提升纳米压印光刻的热与光稳定性并可修复缺陷。

papers.title: Polarity‐Selective Engineering of In‐Gap States in Amorphous Silicon Nitride via Distinct Structural and Electronic Origins
papers.zh: 揭示非晶SiNx中空穴与电子陷阱分别源于结构无序与电子态，实现极性选择的电荷存储调控。

papers.title: Synthetic Whole-Cell Biosensor for Early Transplant Rejection Detection
papers.zh: 构建工程化大肠杆菌全细胞生物传感器，以 toehold 开关逻辑门将尿液核酸标志物转为荧光以早检移植排斥。

papers.title: Remote Plasma‐Enabled Vertical Asymmetry Engineering of 2D PtSe 2 via Phase‐Preserving Chalcogen Exchange
papers.zh: 利用H2S远程等离子体近室温一步硫族交换，在保持相结构下构筑垂直不对称Janus PtSe2。

papers.title: Distinct Photoemission Behaviors in Monolayer WSe 2 : Unidirectional Asymmetry From Edge Defects Versus Bidirectional Expansion From Plasmons
papers.zh: 用TR-PEEM结合第一性原理揭示单层WSe2边缘缺陷致单向不对称展宽、等离激元致双向展宽的光电子发射。

papers.title: Valley Hall viscosity in gapped graphene with and without a magnetic field
papers.zh: 以静态非均匀电场响应定义能隙石墨烯谷 Hall 粘滞，揭示有无磁场下谷分辨响应的对称性。

papers.title: A photonic-integrated optomechanical mid-infrared detector
papers.zh: 将高Q张应力纳米机械谐振器与SiN光子集成电路单片集成，实现紧凑可阵列化的中红外热探测器。

papers.title: Fundamental limits on photonic state preparation from phase-space majorization
papers.zh: 建立相空间弱全相对优超理论，给出Wigner函数下压缩态、猫态、GKP态等光量子态制备的不可行定理。

papers.title: Optimal quantum discrimination at Liouvillian exceptional points
papers.zh: 证明Lindblad系统中EP对弱扰动检测时间标度无根本优势，但特定扰动下可缩短观测时间。

papers.title: Catastrophes in Reconnections of Optical Vortex Rings
papers.zh: 用突变理论研究椭圆高斯光束中光学涡旋环的重联、成核与塌缩等拓扑构型。

papers.title: Eutectic Mixtures of Inorganic and Organic Adamantane‐Type Compounds With Strongly Nonlinear Optical Properties
papers.zh: 将无机-有机金刚烷型团簇与有机金刚烷衍生物形成共晶以降低熔点，同时保留其强非线性光学响应。

papers.title: Adaptive sensing beyond non-adaptive information limits: End-to-end co-design of geometry, policy, and inference
papers.zh: 提出传感器几何、自适应测量策略与推断的端到端协同逆向设计，突破非自适应信息极限。

papers.title: Imaging real-space chiral rotation of flat-band states in helical trilayer graphene
papers.zh: 用STM/STS对比四种石墨烯莫尔体系，在螺旋三层石墨烯中直接观测到平带态的实空间手性旋转。

papers.title: Efficient framework for quantum dynamics driven by nonclassical light
papers.zh: 引入脉冲形 P 表示将非经典光驱动的量子演化分解为准经典分支，高效求解多光子动力学。

papers.title: Point defect tolerance of carrier mobility in Janus MoSSe monolayer

papers.title: Four-photon interference with a high-efficiency quantum dot source
papers.zh: 利用高效率量子点单光子源实现四光子干涉。

papers.title: Nanoscale Mapping of Internal Magnetization Dynamics Reveals How Disorder Shapes Heat Generation in Magnetic Particle Hyperthermia
papers.zh: 结合交流磁测与微磁模拟在纳米尺度解析颗粒内磁化动力学，揭示无序如何调控磁热疗产热。

papers.title: Development and Field Validation of an IoT-Based Smart Beehive Monitoring System for Precision Apiculture
papers.zh: 开发低成本太阳能供电 IoT 智能蜂箱监测系统并完成野外验证。

papers.title: Quantum droplets and condensates in an optical lattice coupled to a dissipative cavity: Collective excitations and nonequilibrium dynamics
papers.zh: 研究光晶格中耦合耗散腔的玻色气体与量子液滴，发现类极化激元能隙模在密度有序相变前软化。

papers.title: Adaptive Information Mining: Approaching the Quantum Limit of Super-Resolution Imaging

papers.title: Direct Imaging of Energy Dissipation in Surface Acoustic Waves

papers.title: Single-crystal growth and physical properties of the antiferromagnetic double perovskite Ba 2 CoMoO 6

papers.title: Influence of pairing and correlations on transport properties in three-terminal superconducting nanostructure
papers.zh: 研究量子点三端超导纳米结构中配对与关联效应，预测负非局域电导与 Seebeck 系数反号。

papers.title: Adaptive Active Illumination Via Translationally and Axially Tunable Cascaded Metasurfaces
papers.zh: 利用可平移与轴向调谐的级联超表面实现自适应主动照明，在准直与扩束间平衡探测距离与覆盖范围。

papers.title: Thin-film lithium tantalate for ultraviolet integrated electro-optic modulator
papers.zh: 在薄膜钽酸锂平台上实现紫外集成电光调制器，兼顾低插损、紧凑与高调制效率。

papers.title: Tailored Dissipation for Directional Transport in Plasmonic Ratchets

papers.title: Quantum simulation using Trotterized disorder Hamiltonians in a single-mode optical cavity
papers.zh: 提出 Trotter 化方案增强无序度，在单模腔 QED 平台量子模拟复 SYK 模型并分析误差。

papers.title: Magnetic excitons in a suspended 2D antiferromagnetic membrane

papers.title: Microscopic constitutive freedom in metamaterials

papers.title: Self-Referenced Diagnosis of SPAD Dark-Count-Rate Switching for Quantum Communication Receivers
papers.zh: 提出基于后脉冲产额比的自参考诊断方法，区分SPAD暗计数本征RTS跳变与杂散光等伪影。

papers.title: Active Learning for Data‐Efficient Optimization of Entangled Granular Metamaterials (Adv. Funct. Mater. 86/2026)

papers.zh: 利用拓扑边缘态腔的超耦合诱导透明与慢光效应实现高灵敏片上THz传感。

papers.title: Coaxial Perovskite Single‐Crystal Fiber Enables Self‐Driven, High‐Sensitivity X‐Ray Detection With Multichannel Spectral Sensing
papers.zh: 同轴钙钛矿单晶光纤解耦吸收路径与载流子输运，实现自驱动高灵敏X射线探测与多通道光谱感知。

papers.title: Determination of Opto‐Structural Parameters to Optimize Blue‐to‐UV Upconversion in Pr 3+ ‐Activated RE BO 3 ( RE = Y, La, Lu) for Phosphor‐Converted UV LEDs
papers.zh: 系统研究Pr3+掺杂REBO3（Y/La/Lu）不同晶型的光-结构参数，优化蓝光到UVC上转换以用于荧光转换紫外LED。

papers.title: A direct observation of ultrafast energy transfer, charge trapping and thermal quenching in inorganic phosphors
papers.zh: 首次结合瞬态吸收与时间分辨发光，直接观测无机长余辉荧光粉中超快能量转移、电荷俘获与热猝灭。

papers.title: Pyro‐Phototronic Effect in Two‐Dimensional Graphene/AgCrP 2 S 6 /Graphene Heterojunction
papers.zh: 在滑移致非中心对称Gr/AgCrP2S6/Gr异质结中发现热释电-光电子效应，热释电系数达9638 µC·m⁻²K⁻¹。

papers.title: Low‐Operating‐Voltage Yellow‐Green LEDs Based on Rationally Designed Copper‐Iodide Hybrid Clusters
papers.zh: 合理设计铜碘杂化团簇发光体以改善载流子注入与传输，实现低工作电压黄绿光无荧光粉LED。

papers.title: Nastrom-Gage-like Energy Spectral Transition in a Minimal Divergent Two-Layer Model
papers.zh: 用最简双层斜压球面模型超高分辨率模拟，复现大气动能谱 k^-3 到 k^-5/3 的 Nastrom-Gage 转变。

papers.title: Stark‐Tunable O‐Band Single‐Photon Sources Based on Deterministically Fabricated Quantum Dot ‐ Circular Bragg Gratings on Silicon
papers.zh: 在硅上确定性制备电接触圆布拉格光栅InGaAs量子点，实现Stark可调O波段单光子源。

papers.title: Hyperuniform Disorder in Photonic Crystal Slabs With Intrinsic Non‐Hermiticity
papers.zh: 理论与数值研究具本征辐射损耗非厄米性的超均匀无序光子晶体板中的光传播。

papers.title: Bright Solitons in Non-Hermitian systems: Exploring the interplay of $\mathcal{PT}$ Symmetry and Wadati Structure
papers.zh: 将复势非线性薛定谔方程按PT与Wadati对称分为四类，研究光孤子的存在性与稳定性。

papers.title: In-situ Control of the Photon-Magnon Synchronized Mode in a Miniaturized Magnetometer
papers.zh: 在 PCB 上实现微型光子-磁子同步模磁强计，用可变电阻原位调控耗散耦合强度，借尖点增强磁场响应。

papers.title: Bi2Se2Te and related tetradymites: SOC-induced optoelectronic tunability and multifaceted physical behavior
papers.zh: 第一性原理研究拓扑绝缘体 Bi2Se2Te 的弹性、声子、电子与光学性质及自旋轨道耦合调控。

papers.title: Parallax-aware and MAB-empowered Beam Training for Modular XL-MIMO Systems
papers.zh: 为模块化 XL-MIMO 提出视差感知与多臂老虎机驱动的近远场混合波束训练方案。

papers.title: When Transition Metal Dichalcogenides Twist: Opportunities for Spintronics and Quantum Technologies
papers.zh: 综述扭转 TMD 莫尔超晶格中的关联态、平带与自旋谷锁定，展望其在自旋电子学和量子技术中的机遇。

papers.title: A Universal Scaling Approach for Transferring Optomechanical and One-Dimensional Photonic Crystal Designs Across Material Platforms
papers.zh: 提出通用缩放方法，将光力与一维光子晶体设计在不同材料平台间迁移。

papers.title: Memristor-coupled discrete chaotic maps for lock-in error suppression in ring laser gyroscopes
papers.zh: 提出忆阻器耦合离散混沌映射方法，用于抑制环形激光陀螺的闭锁误差。

papers.title: OptiLookUp: a microring-based photonic read-only memory lookup table engine for photonic accelerators
papers.zh: 提出基于微环谐振器的功能可选光子只读存储查找表引擎OptiLookUp，服务于光子加速器。

papers.title: Semiconductor optical amplification of a diode-pumped 1-GHz Ti:sapphire oscillator
papers.zh: 对二极管泵浦1 GHz重复频率Ti:sapphire振荡器进行半导体光放大。

papers.title: Road to Practical Manufacturing of Nanopattern‐Scaffolded Functional Devices: From Scalable Mechanical Nanopatterning to Multidimensional Integration With Functional Materials
papers.zh: 综述从可扩展机械纳米图案化到与功能材料多维集成的纳米图案支架器件制造路线。

papers.title: Chiral Au@Semiconductor Yolk–Shell Nanostructures with Tailored Chiroptical Properties and Chirality‐Dependent Photocatalysis
papers.zh: 以手性Au@Cu2O为核自下而上构筑手性Au@半导体蛋黄-壳结构，实现可调手性光学与手性依赖光催化。

papers.title: Frequency-decoupled sparse gated ghost imaging for high-quality reconstruction
papers.zh: 将软阈值重参数化为可微门控嵌入 Transformer，提出鬼成像方法 FD-SGGI，精度优于 Restormer。

papers.title: Color‐Tunable Thermoluminescence From Multi‐Shell Nanocrystals via Ultrasound‐Induced Heating
papers.zh: 设计Tb³⁺/Pr³⁺分区与梯度陷阱多壳氟化物纳米晶，利用超声致热实现颜色可调热释光。

papers.title: Diagnostic-dependent lasting Mpemba effect in a parametrically driven oscillator
papers.zh: 在失谐简并参量放大器中发现迹距离下持久Mpemba反转，而相对熵与HS距离给出不同结论。

papers.title: Parallel Photon‐Correlation LiDAR With Robust Noise Resistance Driven by Super‐Bunching Light
papers.zh: 提出超聚束光驱动的并行光子关联LiDAR，g(2)(0)=177，在信背比1:2750下实现抗噪2D成像与3D重建。

papers.title: In Situ and Dynamic Reconfiguration of Nonlinear Optical Absorption by Carbon Nanotube Optical Fiber
papers.zh: 利用光纤集成单壁碳纳米管吸收体原位调控非线性作用强度，实现可重构饱和吸收与光限幅。

papers.title: Nanoimprint‐Enhanced Organic Heterojunction Phototransistors for Bipolar Optical Encoding in Reservoir Computing
papers.zh: 纳米压印增强有机异质结光晶体管实现双极光响应用于储备池计算，探测下限0.65 µW cm⁻²。

papers.title: Rigid π‐Bridge Conformational Locked Crosslinker for Non‐Destructive Direct Photopatterning of Colloidal Quantum Dot
papers.zh: 设计构象锁定π桥交联剂兼顾刚性与溶解性，实现胶体量子点无损直接光刻图案化用于显示。

papers.title: An Integrated Framework Coupling Hierarchical Hyperspectral i ‐trait Screening, Gene Identification, and Functional Validation for Genetic Dissection of Salt Tolerance in Cotton
papers.zh: 结合动态高光谱表型、分层性状筛选与GWAS，对419份陆地棉耐盐性进行遗传解析。

papers.title: Hydrodynamic Selection of Polymorphic Assembly Pathways in Plant Protein Amyloid Fibrils
papers.zh: 结合AFM与流场分析揭示剪切与涡流如何选择大豆蛋白淀粉样纤维的多态组装路径，识别六种形貌。

papers.title: Enhanced Chromatic X‑Ray Imaging Based on Robust Transparent Nanocrystal Embedded Glass Stacked Scintillator
papers.zh: 构建Y2O3:Eu3+红光膜与纳米晶嵌入玻璃绿光层的堆叠闪烁体，无互激发问题，X射线探测效率提升至165%用于彩色成像。

papers.title: Leaky Topological Edge State Cavities for On‐Chip Terahertz Sensing
papers.zh: 调节谷光子晶体反演对称性使拓扑边缘态越过光锥形成泄漏腔，实验实现高灵敏片上 THz 传感。

papers.title: Symmetry Breaking Enables Direction‐Selective Power Routing Between Diffraction and Dissipation in Obliquely Metallized Opaque Metagratings
papers.zh: 斜向金属化打破对称性，使不透明超光栅在衍射与耗散间实现方向选择性功率路由，并经实验与模型验证。

papers.title: Advancements in Blue Perovskite Light‐Emitting Diodes Enabled by Diammonium‐Based Structural Modulation
papers.zh: 综述二铵阳离子调控策略在稳定宽带隙结构、抑制离子迁移以提升蓝光钙钛矿LED性能中的进展。

papers.title: Ultrabright Thermally Boosted Ln‐MOF X‐Ray Scintillators: A Multifunctional Platform for Upconversion Luminescence and Lipid Droplet Imaging
papers.zh: 以H4TCPB连接Eu4O30簇构建Ln-MOF闪烁体，300–440 K内发光随温度增强，峰值达室温1.96倍，兼具上转换与脂滴成像。

papers.title: A Compact High-Repetition-Rate Intense THz Source for Atomic-Scale Materials Characterization
papers.zh: 基于铌酸锂阶梯镜倾斜波前光整流构建100 kHz紧凑强THz源，转换效率超0.13%。

papers.title: Parallel Spatial–Frequency Diffractive Neural Networks for Autonomous-Driving Visual Understanding
papers.zh: 提出空间-频域并行衍射神经网络SFDNN，提升自动驾驶场景视觉感知性能。

papers.title: Deep eutectic solvent-impregnated cellulose triacetate matrix as a dual- function platform for selective preconcentration and colorimetric detection of Ni(II) ions
papers.zh: 将深共晶溶剂与 PAN 固定于三醋酸纤维素膜，制成 Ni(II) 预富集比色光极，pH 6 下 30 min 显色。

papers.title: Programmable Coherent Memory Kernels for Quantum Reservoir Computing in Waveguide QED
papers.zh: 提出 Kerr 谐振腔多点耦合波导 QED 量子储备池，由几何延迟构建可编程相干非马尔可夫记忆核。

papers.title: Valley-Dependent Photogating-Controlled Quantum Transport in Monolayer Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
papers.zh: 建立陷阱电荷光栅控谷依赖量子输运理论，解释单层 WSe2 与 MoS2 中的负微分电阻。

papers.title: Non-Equilibrium Near-Surface Reconstruction Enhances Chemical-to-Electrical Transduction in Metal Oxide Sensors
papers.zh: 热化学淬火稳定 WO3 非平衡近表面重构，增强金属氧化物气体传感器化学-电信号转换。

papers.title: Ultra-low loss piezo-optomechanical low-confinement silicon nitride platform for visible wavelength quantum photonic circuits
papers.zh: 构建超低损耗低限制SiN压电光力平台，实现低功耗低串扰的可见光量子光子线路重构。

papers.title: A Lightweight Intelligent Bracelet for Real-Time Emergency Detection Using PPG Signals in Solo-Living Elderly
papers.zh: 仅用腕部 PPG 与 8 位量化 CNN-LSTM-Transformer 在 MCU 上实时检测独居老人紧急事件。

papers.title: Tuning ferroptosis-like, cancer-selective cell death with charge-imbalanced nanoparticles
papers.zh: 改变混合电荷配体中负电端基，调控纳米颗粒诱导癌细胞选择性类铁死亡的形式。

papers.title: Spectral Oscillations and Temporal Meandering of Dissipative Solitons in a Moving Intracavity Phase Potential
papers.zh: 研究失谐相位调制产生的移动腔内势中耗散孤子的光谱振荡与时间漫游动力学。

papers.title: Optically gated transduction enables silicon electrical readout of mid-infrared light
papers.zh: 结合 Nd3+ 掺杂纳米颗粒与逆向设计的 Al/p-Si 双共振超表面，以光学门控转导实现硅基中红外电学读出。

papers.title: Studying electron beam coherence using plasmon interference
papers.zh: 利用等离激元干涉研究电子束的相干性。

papers.title: Finite-temperature Quantum Quasinormal Mode Theory for Spatiotemporally-resolved Dissipative Cavity Quantum Magnonics
papers.zh: 发展有限温度量子准正则模理论，严格描述含非互易与耗散的腔量子磁子学体系。

papers.title: Tip-enhanced vibrational ladder climbing in surface molecular system
papers.zh: 在 STM 等离激元纳米间隙中用针尖增强和频产生观测 Pt(111) 上 CO 振动阶梯攀升至 3–4 跃迁。

papers.title: Real-time detection of correlated quasiparticle tunneling events in a multi-qubit superconducting device
papers.zh: 实时检测共置电荷敏感 transmon 中准粒子隧穿，背景速率约 1 Hz，爆发事件约每分钟一次且相关。

papers.title: Hydrogen and lithium Isotope analysis via optical spectroscopy of laser-produced plasmas
papers.zh: 综述基于激光等离子体光谱（LIBS 等）的氢与锂同位素分析方法及其在核能等领域的应用。

papers.title: Efficient assessment of polarization aberrations in optical systems: method development and comparison with existing approaches
papers.zh: 基于取向Zernike多项式分解提出偏振像差简化计算方法，仅需36条采样光线即可高效评估光学系统偏振像差。

papers.title: Perturbative analysis of the Wood anomalies of metallic diffraction gratings
papers.zh: 基于约化Rayleigh方程与多体微扰理论，将金属正弦光栅Wood异常解释为经等离激元的多重散射干涉。

papers.title: Programmable illumination and spatially varying aberration correction in a laser scanning confocal microscopy system
papers.zh: 在激光扫描共聚焦显微系统中实现可编程照明与空间变化像差校正，克服SLM/DMD光束质量退化。

papers.title: Nonlinear optical charge-state switching and pumping to dark state of a diamond nitrogen-vacancy center
papers.zh: 研究金刚石NV色心的非线性光学电荷态切换及向暗态的泵浦。

papers.title: High-Efficiency Graphene Oxide Moiré Lenses Enabled by Cyclic Self-Assembly and Laser Nanoprinting
papers.zh: 以 GO-PDDA 循环自组装结合飞秒激光纳米打印，免掩模制备高效率可连续变焦的氧化石墨烯莫尔透镜。

papers.title: Machine Learning Assisted Design and Optimization of a Dual-Port SIW Antenna with LP-to-CP Conversion for sub-6 GHz 5G Communication System
papers.zh: 用 ANN 与随机森林优化双端口 SIW 线转圆极化天线，覆盖 4.7–5.25 GHz 的 sub-6 GHz 频段。

papers.title: Graphene–ZnO Nanohybrid Synthesis via Wheat Germ Lipase Exfoliation for Environmentally Compatible Antimicrobial Applications
papers.zh: 以小麦胚芽脂肪酶为生物模板水相合成石墨烯-ZnO 纳米杂化物，抑菌圈达 13.2 mm。

papers.title: Generation of quantum light with tunable Wigner negativity with a semiconductor quantum dot
papers.zh: 利用腔中单个半导体量子点相干控制产生零与单光子叠加态，实现 Wigner 负性可调的量子光并经零差测量表征。

papers.title: Millimeter-Wave Horizontally Polarized Wideband and Wide-Angle Beam-Scanning End-Fire Phased Array Based on Active Element Pattern Optimization
papers.zh: 优化阵元方向图，构建1×4水平偏振毫米波端射阵列，覆盖24.4–36.5 GHz宽带扫描。

papers.title: Strain-driven sinusoidal valley control of intermediate-state-mediated hybridized Γ − K excitons
papers.zh: 理论解释应变WS₂的Γ–K激子发光：交换驱动转移再自旋翻转形成直接—间接杂化激子。

papers.title: A High-Performance Absorptive Energy-Selective Surface with Wideband Characteristics
papers.zh: 等效电路指导设计11 GHz双偏振能量选择表面，实现弱入射低损耗透射与强入射高吸收。

papers.title: A Cost-Effective Object-Trackable Wireless Power Transfer System for Battery-Free IoT Terminals Enabled by an Ultracompact and Wideband Rectenna with Highly Efficient Harmonic Backscattering
papers.zh: 用整流天线被动二次谐波背散射确定接收方向，引导聚焦无线供能波束，无需额外主动反馈。

papers.title: A Shared-Aperture Metasurface Antenna for Simultaneous RF Energy Harvesting and Wireless Communications
papers.zh: 提出共口径超表面天线，同时实现射频能量收集与无线通信功能。

papers.title: Collective Optical Excitations and Photoexcited-Carrier Dynamics in the Na 20 @C 240 Core-Shell Nanostructure
papers.zh: 实时 TDDFT 研究 Na20@C240 核壳光学响应与载流子动力学，Na20 共振位于 2.73 eV。

papers.title: A Near-Field-Coupler-Enabled Distributed Antenna Architecture for Smartphone Satellite Communications
papers.zh: 近场耦合器把手机处理与卫星通信天线分离，利用耦合共振和错位几何降低RF损耗。

papers.title: Ultrafast light-electron modulation for free-electron quantum optics: fundamentals and applications
papers.zh: 建立统一的光-电子调制（LEM）框架，将光学近场视为自由电子波包的可编程相位调制器，统一描述 PINEM、KDE 与 DLA。

papers.title: Staircase-Induced Symmetry Breaking in Yee-FDTD and Its Suppression by Triangular-Grid FDTD
papers.zh: 分析Yee阶梯网格导致的人工对称破缺和模态分裂，采用三角网格FDTD减轻离散伪影。

papers.title: Near-Field Radiation and Scattering Characteristics of a Dipole in the Presence of an Anisotropic Plasma Sphere
papers.zh: 冷等离子体球模型中推导近距外部偶极散射，考察各向异性与弯曲波前对近场耦合的影响。

papers.title: Geometric modulation of transition and survival intensities in non-Hermitian systems
papers.zh: 将复 Berry 相位几何调制推广到多能级非厄米系统，揭示非厄米 Landau-Zener 跃迁与存活强度的非互易。

papers.title: Compact Metasurface-Enabled Wireless Power Transfer for Long-Range Low Frequency Delivery to Miniaturized Retinal and Neural Implants
papers.zh: 提出紧凑型超表面无线输能方案，实现对微型视网膜与神经植入物的远距离低频能量传输。

papers.title: Time-Reversal Characteristic Modes of Lossy Reciprocal Structures
papers.zh: 基于收发互易提出有耗互易结构的时间反演特征模分解，有耗情况下仍保持辐射功率正交。

papers.title: Full-space Metasurface with Four Polarization-Decoupled Channels and Independent Phase Control Based on Guided-wave architecture
papers.zh: 基于导波馈电架构设计全空间超表面，实现四个偏振解耦通道及其独立相位调控。

papers.title: SAW-driven Magnetoelectric Antenna Array with Enhanced Radiation Efficiency for High-rate Data Transmission and Microwave Field Detection
papers.zh: FeGaB/压电绝缘体大阵列以表面声波限域提高磁电天线Q值与辐射，面向微波场检测和通信。

papers.title: Efficient 3D Airborne TEM Modeling with Arbitrary-Shaped Antennas Using the Rational Arnoldi Method
papers.zh: 用有理Arnoldi方法提高任意形状航空瞬变电磁天线的三维正演效率，属地球物理建模。

papers.title: A Reconfigurable Multipolarization Horn Antenna Enabled by Mechanical Switching in Groove Gap Waveguide-Based Feed Layer
papers.zh: 基于槽隙波导馈电层的机械切换，实现可重构多极化喇叭天线。

papers.title: A Wideband Dual-Polarized 1-Bit Radiation-type Reconfigurable Metasurface with Independent 2-D Beam Scanning for Ka -Band Applications
papers.zh: 提出宽带双极化 1-bit 辐射型可重构超表面，实现 Ka 波段独立二维波束扫描。

papers.title: Solid-state laser refrigeration of nanoscale quantum sensors
papers.zh: 通过对陶瓷衬底进行固态激光制冷，抑制纳米金刚石和金纳米晶等纳米量子传感器的光热升温。

papers.title: In vitro binding energies capture Klf4 occupancy across the human genome
papers.zh: 测量转录因子 Klf4 与基序及非基序 DNA 的体外结合能，以定量预测其在人类基因组中的占据分布。

papers.title: Electromotive entrainment of charge and heat currents in graphene
papers.zh: 建立行波（如声表面波）驱动石墨烯近中性点电荷与热流的流体动力学理论并给出二阶解析式。

papers.title: 33.1 nm Wide-Tuning High-Power Blue-Green Semiconductor Disk Laser and Its Application in Underwater Wireless Optical Communication with Various Water Types
papers.zh: 双增益芯片半导体碟片激光器经 LBO 腔内倍频，实现 484.5–517.6 nm 共 33.1 nm 调谐、12.43 W 输出并用于水下光通信。

papers.title: Stacking-Order-Dependent Electronic Properties of MoTe2/WSe2 Moiré Bilayers
papers.zh: 用 STEM 校准 SHG 堆垛判定，比较 MoTe2/WSe2 莫尔双层两种堆垛序的输运、磁性与电子相图。

papers.title: Di-functional 2D Cu-MOF nanosheets nanozyme inhibitor for the modulation and sensing of α-Chymotrypsin enzyme activity
papers.zh: 构建二维 Cu-MOF 纳米片纳米酶抑制剂，兼具 α-胰凝乳蛋白酶活性调控与传感功能。

papers.title: Diagonal, Switching, and Locally Optimal Unraveling for efficient quantum trajectories in metastable open quantum systems
papers.zh: 提出对角、切换及局部最优展开方法，高效模拟亚稳开放量子系统（如非线性驱动谐振腔）的量子轨迹。

papers.title: GaN MIS-HEMT-based 2T1C circuit for wide-frequency-range μLED displays
papers.zh: 提出基于GaN MIS-HEMT的2T1C像素驱动电路，用于宽频率范围μLED显示。

papers.title: Landscape of scattering universality with general dispersion relations
papers.zh: 研究色散ε(k)=|k|^m的一维散射，分类零能S矩阵普适不动点，仅由指数m与有限整数决定。

papers.title: Tapering to Enhance the Performance of Nanowire-Based Fluorescent Biosensors
papers.zh: 电磁模拟表明锥形高折射率纳米线可显著增强荧光生物传感信号，锥长 8000 nm 时激发增强超过直纳米线三倍。

papers.title: Ultrasensitive Enantioselective Chiroptical Sensing with Large-Area Twisted Aligned Carbon Nanotube Films
papers.zh: 手性分子吸附于扭转堆叠的取向碳纳米管薄膜，产生大紫外 CD 信号，实现超灵敏对映选择性手性传感。

papers.title: Parametrically Enhanced Ergotropy and Charging Power in a Three-Mode Bosonic Quantum Battery
papers.zh: 提出三模玻色量子电池方案，利用压缩光与简并 OPA 及干涉非互易性增强能量提取量与充电功率。

papers.title: High spectral resolution mid-infrared hyperspectral computational ghost imaging enabled by wavelength-tunable nonlinear structured illumination
papers.zh: 利用差频产生将近红外空间图样转移为波长可调中红外结构光，实现高光谱分辨率中红外高光谱鬼成像。

papers.title: From Artificial to Embodied and Physical Intelligence in Smart Manufacturing
papers.zh: 综述以人工智能、具身智能与物理智能三层框架推动智能制造的发展路径与挑战。

papers.title: Theoretical description of high-harmonic spectroscopy for uniaxial nematic and isotropic liquid crystals
papers.zh: 发展半经验紧束缚理论，用高次谐波光谱探测向列与各向同性液晶的非线性光学各向异性及有序参量。

papers.title: Strain-Engineered Deterministic Quantum Dots for Telecom O-Band Emission Using Buried Stressors
papers.zh: 利用埋入式 AlAs/AlOx 应力层诱导拉伸应变，实现定位 InGaAs 量子点约 1.3 μm 的电信 O 波段发射。

papers.title: Harnessing In-Fiber Microstructural Nonlinearity via Cascaded Microcavities for Efficient Optical Neural Computing
papers.zh: 利用级联微腔激发光纤内微结构非线性，实现高效光学神经网络计算。

papers.title: Coherent Composite-Vortex Fields for Multi-Mode High-Order OAM Spatial Coding in Turbulent Links
papers.zh: 利用相干复合涡旋场实现多模高阶OAM空间编码，用于湍流链路中的光通信。

papers.title: Ultrasensitive strain modulation of terahertz magnons at a magnetic phase transition
papers.zh: 用共振X射线衍射与Raman在Ca2RuO4中实现单轴应变调控反铁磁基态，THz磁振子能量变化超10%。

papers.title: Plasma and light: Shaping High Harmonic Generation in Time-Varying Media
papers.zh: 研究强驱动时变透明导电氧化物中等离子体演化与固体高次谐波产生的耦合，提出双场泵浦调控方案。

papers.title: Nonlinear coupling between motional modes in trapped-ion quantum processors
papers.zh: 建立囚禁离子晶体中三阶库仑项引起的运动模非线性耦合模型，量化其对Molmer-Sorensen门的影响。

papers.title: Complementary Metal-Oxide Semiconductor-Compatible Phototransistor Platform for Neuromorphic Broadband Vision
papers.zh: 将胶体量子点与 SOI 沟道集成为 CMOS 兼容双栅突触晶体管，覆盖 300–1700 nm，1550 nm 响应度 639 A/W。

papers.title: Optical Speckle Patterns as Nonlinear Feature Maps for Photonic Machine Learning
papers.zh: 基于集成光子环形多程腔产生光学散斑作为非线性特征映射，评估其用于机器学习与模式识别的能力。

papers.title: Bio-inspired hierarchical plasmonic meta-architectures for silicon-based near-infrared sensing
papers.zh: 受孔雀羽毛启发设计多尺度等离激元超结构，与 TiN/Si 肖特基结协同实现硅基近红外热载流子探测。

papers.title: MoS2-based composites with magnetoelectric synergistic loss for enhanced microwave absorption
papers.zh: 磁电协同损耗的 MoS2 复合吸波材料，在 1.9 mm 厚度下有效吸收带宽达 4.36 GHz。

papers.title: XL MIMO Extreme Learning Machines: Wave-Domain Inference with Stacked Metasurfaces
papers.zh: 利用堆叠超表面在 XL MIMO 信道中实现极限学习机式波域推理，将多层神经网络计算卸载至信道。

papers.title: Point-of-Care Localized Surface Plasmon Resonance (LSPR) Systems for Medical Diagnostics
papers.zh: 综述基于局域表面等离激元共振的即时检测医学诊断系统的进展与挑战。

papers.title: Electron-photon entanglement in real space from quantum electrodynamics
papers.zh: 从非相对论 QED 出发在实空间与时间上数值求解电子与其散射光子的纠缠，无需旋波近似。

papers.title: Parameter-Decoupling-Informed Learning for Superresolution: Laboratory Validation and Galaxy Imaging
papers.zh: 提出参数解耦启发的 CNN 学习模型估计点源亚波长间距，经实验图像验证并用于星系成像。

papers.title: HarP: a simulation tool for high-order harmonic generation and propagation in gases
papers.zh: 发布开源 Python 工具 HarP，结合预计算偶极表模拟气体中高次谐波的产生与宏观传播。

papers.title: Multimode continuous-variable quantum key distribution with CMOS-compatible photonic-electronic integration
papers.zh: 构建 CMOS 兼容光电集成多模 CV-QKD 架构，以硅光芯片与 28 nm CMOS 跨阻放大器实现偏振复用双模密钥分发。

papers.title: Au Nanoparticle-Functionalized Antheraea pernyi Silk Nanofibrils: A Spatially Adaptive Anti-Inflammatory and Pro-Regenerative Paradigm for Disparate Chronic Epithelial Diseases
papers.zh: 金纳米颗粒功能化柞蚕丝纳米纤丝，结合催化推进与 NIR 光热，用于多种慢性上皮疾病的抗炎促修复治疗。

papers.title: Demonstration of a Monolithic V-Shaped Path Ultraviolet Laser Based on a Single LBO Crystal
papers.zh: 基于单块LBO晶体演示单片V形光路紫外激光器。

papers.title: Dual quasi-bound states in the continuum enabling stable intensity-domain nonreciprocity in a dimer metasurface
papers.zh: 在二聚体超表面中利用双准 BIC 实现稳定的强度域非互易响应。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian quantization switching via linear and circular polarization in Sm3+: BiPO4
papers.zh: 在Sm3+:BiPO4中通过线偏振与圆偏振切换实现非厄米量子化切换。

papers.title: Multi-field synergistic terahertz detection via 3D-printed vortex metasurface with Mn3Sn thin film
papers.zh: 将 3D 打印涡旋超表面与 Mn3Sn 薄膜结合，实现多场协同的 THz 探测。

papers.title: Low-loss robust three-dimensional unidirectional magnetoplasmons at terahertz frequencies
papers.zh: 提出 THz 频段低损耗、鲁棒的三维单向磁等离激元传输结构。

papers.title: Accurate beam steering of cascaded 1D optical phased arrays with a physics-informed residual network
papers.zh: 利用物理信息残差网络实现级联光学相控阵的精确光束扫描控制。

papers.title: Quantum Two-Way Time Transfer with Physics-Informed Algorithmic Dispersion Compensation
papers.zh: 提出量子双向时间传递方案，并采用物理信息算法进行色散补偿。

papers.title: Spatial filters with ultrabroadband noise rejection and high contrast based on All-dielectric High-contrast Grating Metasurfaces
papers.zh: 基于全介质高对比度光栅超表面设计具有超宽带噪声抑制和高对比度的空间滤波器。

papers.title: Phase and Intensity X-ray Linearization with Dark Field (PIXLD): A Fast Algorithm for Low Coherence X-ray Phase-Contrast and Dark Field Imaging Compatible with Medical and Industrial X-ray Sources
papers.zh: 提出PIXLD快速算法，在低相干医用/工业X射线源下实现相衬与暗场成像。

papers.title: Physical Layer Encryption for Coherent PDM System Based on Optical Domain Polarization Perturbation
papers.zh: 提出基于光域偏振扰动的相干PDM系统物理层加密方案。

papers.title: Direct blue LED pumped Pr:YLF laser
papers.zh: 演示以蓝光LED直接泵浦的Pr:YLF激光器。

papers.title: A Robust Multi-frame Structured Joint SERDS Reconstruction Method under Non-stationary Excitation
papers.zh: 提出非稳态激发下鲁棒的多帧结构化联合SERDS重建方法，用于移频激发拉曼差分光谱。

papers.title: Surface-normal electric spin in obliquely excited parallel-slit SPP fields
papers.zh: 斜入射s偏振光照射平行狭缝阵列产生周期可由入射角调谐的交替表面法向电自旋，并揭示基底/空气侧激发的差异。

papers.title: Waveguide-band synthesis for electronic terahertz fingerprint spectroscopy
papers.zh: 提出波导频段合成方法，实现电子学太赫兹指纹光谱测量。

papers.title: Aluminum-free high-efficiency Tm 3+ nanoparticle-doped silica fiber laser
papers.zh: 研制无铝 Tm3+ 纳米颗粒掺杂石英光纤，实现高效率光纤激光输出。

papers.title: Alloy engineering of excitonic properties in TMD monolayers
papers.zh: 光谱研究单层MoS2xSe2(1-x)合金，光学带隙连续调谐约0.35 eV，圆偏振度由近0增至约15%。

papers.title: Photoacoustic model for laser-induced desorption of nanoparticles
papers.zh: 建立光声模型解释激光诱导纳米颗粒脱附的机理。

papers.title: Theoretical study of high-order harmonic generation in solids based on deep-learning methods
papers.zh: 结合深度学习分子动力学与紧束缚哈密顿量高效计算大尺度非晶固体高次谐波，并以单层 h-BN 验证。

papers.title: Complex-Fields Meta-Microscopy with High Spatial and Phase-Gradient Resolution
papers.zh: 提出复场超表面显微术，实现高空间分辨率与高相位梯度分辨率的复振幅成像。

papers.title: Hundred milliwatts integrated mid-infrared femtosecond lasers
papers.zh: 实现百毫瓦级输出的集成中红外飞秒激光器。

papers.title: Association of fetal activity patterns in utero with postnatal sleep behavior
papers.zh: 用可穿戴传感器连续监测 32 对母婴孕晚期胎动，发现胎儿昼夜活动模式与出生后睡眠行为相关。

papers.title: Cool down and amp up: radiative cooling boosts power grid cable ampacity and safety
papers.zh: 评述高导热辐射制冷涂层用于架空电缆，户外测试显示降低线温与弧垂并提升载流量。

papers.title: Effects of Pulse Duration on Kerr Self-Focusing and Weld Formation in Ultrafast Laser Welding of Fused Silica
papers.zh: 研究 262 fs 至 10 ps 脉宽对熔融石英超快激光焊接中 Kerr 自聚焦、焊缝位置与剪切强度的影响。

papers.title: Memory efficient Fresnel diffraction from an interpolated wavefront to a limited ROI using matrix multiplication
papers.zh: 提出基于组合矩阵乘法的Fresnel衍射计算，仅计算感兴趣区域且几乎无误差，显著降低计算量和内存。

papers.title: A Control Line Multiplexing Framework for Scalable Quantum Computing
papers.zh: 提出全微波频分复用控制线框架，以共享传输线实现可扩展超导量子计算的门控制。

papers.title: Physics-guided Lorentzian sparse representation framework for accelerated parametric modeling of sparse S -parameters in MPCVD resonators
papers.zh: 提出物理引导的洛伦兹稀疏表示框架，加速高Q值MPCVD谐振腔稀疏S参数的参数化建模。

papers.title: Floquet Modulation for Measuring Probe-Induced Shifts in Optical Lattice Clocks
papers.zh: 提出Floquet频率调制测量光晶格钟探测光AC Stark频移系数，在相同时间下降低测量不确定度。

papers.title: Quantized-resonance description of a quantum emitter dynamics in a lossy multimode cavity
papers.zh: 用量子化共振模型研究有损腔中的发射体动力学，说明描述多模特征需要多个腔模。

papers.title: Near-Infrared-Responsive Au Nanorod/UiO-66-NH2 Hybrids for Photocatalytic Carbon Dioxide Conversion
papers.zh: 将等离激元Au纳米棒原位封装于UiO-66-NH2 MOF，构建近红外响应超宽带光催化剂驱动CO2还原。

papers.title: Accurate measurement of Lithium Tantalate birefringence in whispering gallery resonators
papers.zh: 利用钽酸锂回音壁谐振腔高分辨光谱精确测定其双折射大小与符号，澄清长期争议。

papers.title: Quantitative mobile gamma-ray spectrometry through Bayesian inference
papers.zh: 结合移动伽马能谱、蒙特卡洛模拟与全谱贝叶斯推断，仅用 6 s 数据实现源识别（>5σ）与米级定位。

papers.title: Cephalopod-inspired embodied camouflage system for simultaneous evasion of artificial and human visual perception
papers.zh: 提出仿头足类闭环伪装系统CephCam，结合环境取色、纹理优化与角度补偿显示，同时躲避AI检测与人眼。

papers.title: Analysis of C-point and V-point Inhomogeneous Vector Beams Stability under Anisotropic Turbulence in Ground-to-Air Transmission
papers.zh: 分析含 C 点与 V 点偏振奇点的 LG 与圆 Airy 矢量光束在地空各向异性湍流中的传输稳定性。

papers.title: Plasmonic vortex cavities toward the ultra-compact limit
papers.zh: 提出基于 MIM 间隙等离激元的涡旋腔，尺寸小于 λ/10、环形特征小于 λ/60，实现超紧凑 OAM 限域。

papers.title: Functional MXene Inks for Printed Electronics: Chemistry, Rheology, and Devices
papers.zh: 综述 MXene 功能墨水的化学、流变学与印刷电子器件之间的构效关系。

papers.title: Peptide Stapling: A Strategy for Enhanced Molecular Recognition of C-Reactive Protein
papers.zh: 对CRP结合肽进行订书钉环化以提升构象稳定性，仅P9肽在环化后保留CRP结合活性。

papers.title: Yielding Enhanced Gas Sensing in WO3 Thin Films via p-n Heterojunction Formation
papers.zh: 共溅射制备WO3/Ag2O p-n异质结薄膜，75 °C下对25 ppm CH4灵敏度达70.61%。

papers.title: Tunable turning point of the frequency--temperature response in suspended bilayer SiN_x/Al nanofilms
papers.zh: 利用悬空 SiNx/Al 双层纳米薄膜振动本征频率实现单调连续的低温非侵入测温，并可调节频温拐点。

papers.title: Multimodal Spectroscopy–Driven Reconstruction of Three-Dimensional Molecular Structures via Conditional Diffusion Model
papers.zh: 提出SpecDiffMol条件扩散模型，从分子式与IR、Raman、UV-vis、NMR多模态光谱重建三维分子结构。

papers.title: Microstructural evolution, phase transformations and magnetic characteristics of Fe@Fe3O4@NaCl core-shell nanocomposites when varying the EB PVD synthesis temperature
papers.zh: 研究EB PVD沉积温度对Fe@Fe3O4@NaCl核壳纳米复合物相组成与磁性的影响。

papers.title: Solvent-Controlled Electronic Structure, Aromaticity and Nonlinear Optical Properties of a Butylene-Dioxy-Bridged Bis(Anthranilamide) Schiff Base: A DFT and Docking Study
papers.zh: 合成双邻氨基苯甲酰胺Schiff碱并用DFT研究溶剂对其电子结构与NLO性质影响，气相HOMO-LUMO隙4.009 eV。

papers.title: Emergent Molecular Weaving in an Ionic Metal‐Organic Network for CO 2 Conversion
papers.zh: 以 Cu2+ 与 TNPG 水相合成离子型编织金属有机网络，用于 CO2 转化。

papers.title: Geometric calibration of central omnidirectional cameras under the unit-viewing sphere model
papers.zh: 提出单位视球模型下中心全向相机的几何标定方法。

papers.title: Towards fault-tolerant quantum computing with optically controlled superconducting qubits
papers.zh: 探讨利用光学控制超导量子比特迈向容错量子计算的方案。

papers.title: Energy-focused illumination via phase-only wavefront modulation for computational imaging
papers.zh: 利用纯相位波前调制实现能量聚焦照明，以提升计算成像性能。

papers.title: Photonic cavity architectures for enhanced Rydberg atom-based electrometry: numerical study
papers.zh: 数值研究多种光子腔结构对Rydberg原子电场测量灵敏度的增强作用。

papers.title: Red–green–blue random lasers for high-resolution speckle-free color imaging in scattering environments
papers.zh: 基于染料掺杂 SiO2 纳米颗粒介质实现红绿蓝随机激光（阈值 64.3–112.6 μJ），用于散射环境无散斑彩色成像。

papers.title: Tailored spectral tuning of polaritons in isotope-enriched hyperbolic hetero-bicrystals via twist engineering
papers.zh: 利用同位素富集范德华异质双晶的扭转杂化调谐声子极化激元，实现双谱隙与可配置定向传播。

papers.title: Free electron radiation based on gradient metasurfaces
papers.zh: 提出基于梯度超表面的自由电子辐射机制，将电子束表面波转为定向 THz 辐射，角度可由电子速度和相位梯度调节。

papers.title: Broadband magnetically tunable terahertz isolator based on a metasurface–RIG Faraday rotator
papers.zh: 基于超表面-稀土铁石榴石法拉第旋转器实现宽带 THz 隔离器，室温 0.22 T 磁场下工作。

papers.title: High-stability offset-frequency locking of two lasers using a balanced filter discriminator
papers.zh: 基于平衡滤波鉴频器实现两台 852 nm 激光器 8.653 GHz 高稳定偏频锁定。

papers.title: Optimization of Prostate T2-Weighted Imaging Using AI-Assisted Compressed Sensing Combined with Deep Learning Reconstruction: A Prospective Study
papers.zh: 前瞻性评估AI辅助压缩感知结合深度学习重建用于前列腺T2加权MRI，缩短扫描时间并提升图像质量。

papers.title: Data-efficient linear hyperspectral imaging through risk-guided co-design
papers.zh: 提出风险引导的编码-重建协同设计框架，以少量数据实现目前最优的线性高光谱计算成像重建。

papers.title: Non-catalytic Highly Selective Olefin Production from Complex Hydrocarbons via Pulsed Joule Heating
papers.zh: 利用脉冲焦耳加热无催化剂裂解复杂烃类，获得与催化裂解相当的轻烯烃产率。

papers.title: Spatially Variable Period Modulation Enables High-Efficiency Large-Field-of-View Metalens
papers.zh: 提出空间可变周期调制策略并结合预计算数据库快速设计，实现大视场高效率超透镜成像。

papers.title: Emergent Higher-Order Optical Nonlinearity in Self-Assembled Polar Supertextures
papers.zh: 在自组装极性斯格明子中发现中红外激发下巨大超快 SHG，源于高阶光学非线性。

papers.title: A Fast and Accurate Source-Mask Optimization Flow Using a Unified Abbe-Hopkins Framework
papers.zh: 提出统一Abbe-Hopkins框架下快速精确的光刻光源-掩模联合优化流程。

papers.title: On-chip high-repetition-rate passively mode-locked frequency comb source based on a microring composite cavity
papers.zh: 基于微环复合腔实现片上高重复频率被动锁模光频梳源。

papers.title: Low-divergence GaSb-based semiconductor lasers via monolithically integrated MMI transverse-field engineering
papers.zh: 通过单片集成MMI横向场工程实现低发散角GaSb基半导体激光器。

papers.title: Fine-Grained Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation via Optical–DSM Collaborative Enhancement and Frequency-Guided Decoding
papers.zh: 提出光学-DSM协同增强与频率引导解码网络，提升遥感影像细粒度语义分割精度。

papers.title: Nanoscale mapping of native defects in Td-MoTe2 and their impact on graphene-based van der Waals heterostructures
papers.zh: 用 STM/STS 纳米尺度表征 Td-MoTe2 中 Te 空位及其对石墨烯/MoTe2 异质结电子结构的影响。

papers.title: Scalable Fabrication of Thermally Reconfigurable Ge Metasurfaces Using Stencil Lithography for Mid‐Infrared Molecular Fingerprinting
papers.zh: 用模板光刻大面积制备 Ge 柱 Mie 共振超表面，结合热调谐覆盖 950–1700 cm-1 指纹区用于 SEIRAS。

papers.title: Simulation-Driven Design of Guardrail Structural Spacers: Influence of Geometry on Impact Response
papers.zh: 用经实车碰撞验证的显式有限元模型比较常规与菱形护栏间隔件几何对冲击响应的影响。

papers.title: Helical Conductive Pathways Bridge Polarization Centers at Hollow‐Confined Metal/N‐C Interfaces to Form a Coherent Electromagnetic Loss Network
papers.zh: 构建空心限域金属/N-C 界面上的螺旋导电通路，形成相干电磁损耗网络以提升轻质微波吸收。

papers.title: Heisenberg-Scaling Quantum Metrology of Electron-Photon Coupling via Multi-Electron PINEM
papers.zh: 证明多电子 PINEM 耦合强度估计的量子 Fisher 信息随电子数平方增长，并提出压缩光零差方案达到 Heisenberg 极限。

papers.title: Scaling metasurface design: from reusable unit cells to full-metasurface inverse design
papers.zh: 评述超表面设计从可复用单元库到整体超表面逆向设计的规模化发展。

papers.title: Cross-Level Gated Dual-Attention Network for Landslide Segmentation in Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.zh: 提出跨层门控双注意力网络CLGDA-Net，用于遥感影像中的滑坡精确分割。
